source-o.table-s: 4.2.2.9 USB 2.0 High-Speed OTG: High-Speed mode (480 Mbit/s); pins USB_DP/USB_DM p29
USB 2.0 Full-speed: by default USB Serial/JTAG uses GPIO24/25 (USB1P1_N0/P0)
USB 2.0 Full-Speed OTG uses GPIO26/27 (USB1P1_N1/P1) by default

component-o.description-s: High-performance dual-core 32-bit RISC-V SoC with low-power RISC-V core, integrated image signal processor (ISP), MIPI CSI-2 camera and MIPI DSI display interfaces, hardware JPEG and H.264 codecs, voice activity detection, up to 16 MB or 32 MB in-package PSRAM, high-speed USB 2.0 OTG, Ethernet MAC, rich set of SPI/I2C/UART/SDIO/GPIO peripherals, and operating temperature from -40 °C to 85 °C.
